name: Union Pioneer Public Company Limited
summary: Union Pioneer Public Company Limited manufactures and distributes finished elastic products in Thailand, the United States, and internationally. The company provides textile, hygiene, and industrial products, including covering yarn; elastic webbing and crochet; elastic braids; and elastic rubber threads and tapes. It also offers medical products, such as esmark, conforming, and elastic bandages; tourniquets; and anti-slip rubber sheets. In addition, the company provides exercise and rehab products comprising multi-loop and exercise bands. Further, it offers its products under Venus brand. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand. Union Pioneer Public Company Limited is a subsidiary of Saha-Union Public Company Limited.
